newsitem.title: CHINA: China jails four police for torture.
newsitem.headline: China jails four police for torture.

text.p: A court in eastern China has sentenced four policemen to up to 11 years' jail for torturing a bank robbery suspect to death, the Worker's Daily said on Saturday.
The Yunhe County People's Court in Jiangsu province sentenced the four on December 27 for killing Lin Zhuhua, a driver at a local bank, when questioning him over a robbery, the newspaper said.
The police had tortured Lin with electric shocks and beaten him with wooden clubs, the newspaper said.
Lin was suspected of involvement in the theft of 80,000 yuan ($9,640) from the bank last May, it said.
The police were given sentences of 11, five, four and three years, it said. It gave no further details.
International human rights groups say torture is commonly used by police in rural China to extract confessions.
